findings.origin: implementer:self-review (FR6 N1; not an independent review)
findings.property: unsigned wraparound of the FNV-1a product (and of the xorshift64 left shifts) could trap the integer gate's unsigned-integer-overflow check
findings.severity: low: a trap stops the integer gate; no memory-safety effect
findings.rationale: FNV-1a 64 is defined modulo 2^64, so its product wraps for almost every input. Each review unit names a source file, src/<unit>.c, and its locations are line numbers in that file. source_identity is the sha256 of json.dumps({path: sha256}, sort_keys=True) over the example files under src/, include/, tests/project/, fuzz/project/, specs/project/ and review/ (paths relative to examples/bench-demo, review/ledger.json excluded).
findings.reproducer: tests/project/test_bd_digest.c vector rows {0x0000000000000000U, 1000000U, ...} and {0xdeadbeefcafef00dU, 1000000U, ...} under the integer gate (-fsanitize=undefined,unsigned-integer-overflow,implicit-integer-conversion)

history.reason: Not a defect: src/bd_digest.c:12 computes the product with __builtin_mul_overflow, which stores the product modulo 2^64 and is not instrumented as an overflow; the unsigned left shifts at lines 30 and 32 are defined and are not unsigned-integer-overflow operations. The integer gate runs the 1,000,000-step vectors without a report (project check run d394522954064b5084f76af19252f8fd).

findings.origin: approver:FR6 N1 verdict finding N1-A01 (fresh-context adversarial approver, artifacts/approvals/framework-release-FR6-N1/verdict.md)
findings.property: bd_digest_request writes output record i before it reads request record i + 1; an in-place or overlapping request and output gave wrong output with status BD_OK, and the specification did not forbid the overlap
findings.severity: medium: wrong output with a success status for an overlapping caller (for example one shared memory region in N3); no out-of-bounds access
findings.rationale: The repair refuses the overlapping pair with BD_OVERLAP after the length and capacity checks and before any write. The check compares pointers for equality only (points_into, src/bd_digest.c:123), which C defines for pointers into different objects. The specification states the rule, and the Python reference documents it. regression_identity is the sha256 of tests/project/test_bd_request.c; the before run is project check 829f6c3c90004aa7bbff3ef062cf6524 (gate unit FAIL: test_bd_request failed) and the after run is project check 8e97919cae6f4e6280ba803c7731e6da (exit 3, 23 of 23 gates PASS), both with the same regression file. N2-A03 (FR6 N3): the after run 8e97919c ran the same C sources and regression file with an older spec and ledger text; project check a978f89051904aa9954a382f46abdc30 (exit 3, 23 of 23 gates PASS) is the run of the recorded source identity 0396ad8e.
findings.reproducer: tests/project/test_bd_request.c overlap(): overlap_case(0U, 11U, 16U, 5U, BD_OVERLAP) and the other overlapping cases in one 64-byte area
